html: A sore lower back is one of the most common reasons people see a clinician. Most episodes come from strained muscles or ligaments and ease on their own over days to weeks.

• Keep moving with gentle walks instead of staying in bed
  • Use a heating pad or a cold pack, whichever feels better
  • Lift with your legs and keep loads close to your body
  • Stand up and stretch every so often if you sit for long periods
The pain follows a fall or injury, or comes with numbness in the legs or groin, trouble controlling your bladder or bowels, fever, or pain that keeps getting worse.

title: Low back pain
abstract: Most back pain eases with time and movement. Here's what helps and when to get care.
